Options

Special Notes

This game uses EasyAntiCheat (EAC) protection, please follow these instructions to disable EAC:

1. Click the “Install Anti-Cheat Bypass” button.
2. Select “start_protected_game.exe” from your game’s root folder\Game folder and save.
3. Launch or restart the game.
